instruction.name: xvssrarni.d.q
instruction.description: Arithmetic right shift with rounding the signed 128-bit elements in `a` and `b` by `imm`, saturate the result to signed 64-bit, write the 64-bit results into `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvssrarni.d.q $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvssrarni.d.q $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvssrarni.d.q $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvssrarni.d.q $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvssrarni.d.q $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvssrarni.d.q $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvssrarni.d.q $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvssrarni.d.q $xr7, $xr15, 1
